title: The orientation of an integer multiplicity triple orients the chosen approximate tangent plane a.e.
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n). Then for H^n-almost every x ∈ M (with respect to μHE[n] restricted to M), ξ(x) is a unit orientation of approxTangentPlane n M x. That is, there are orthonormal τ_1, …, τ_n spanning approxTangentPlane n M x such that either ξ(x)(α) = α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for all n-covectors α, or ξ(x)(α) = −α(τ_1, …, τ_n) for all n-covectors α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), IsUnitOrientationOf (R.orient x) (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x)
